desc:
✨Welcome to Killstreak Swords V4✨

This is a swords and streaks game, defeating enemies to become stronger reaching amazing phases with incredible visual effects and music
This game is generally not recommended for low-end devices, and if you persist you may experience very noticeable FPS drops.

If you're new, it's recommended to play on a private server, they're completely free
Then equip the first sword you see called "Soul Stealer"
And then look for easy enemies to fight in your early phases

Unlock more powerful and incredible swords by completing ingame mysteries, earning LB, and badges!
But do you really think it's just about fighting enemies to get better phases and auras? Find out for yourself...

All rights to the music are not owned by the game, credits to their respective creators
especially some special ones: 
DM Dokuro, 
Desolo Zantas, 
Forza Sans, 
Sakuzyo, 
etc...
